title: Show Error message in applet when powerdevil isn't running instead of hiding the applet completely from the tray
line: Brightness & Color now stays in the system tray when the power management service isn't running and explains why brightness can't be adjusted.
explanation: The applet's metadata had X-Plasma-DBusActivationService set to org.kde.Solid.PowerManagement, so the system tray only loaded Brightness & Color while powerdevil was on the bus and unloaded it as soon as the service went away. That also took Night Light and the dark mode switch with it, even though those don't depend on powerdevil. The change drops that key so the applet is always loaded, exposes whether org.kde.ScreenBrightness is registered as isServiceAvailable, and shows an error message at the top of the popup while it isn't.

commits.message:
applets/brightness: show an error instead of disappearing without powerdevil

The tray only loaded Brightness & Color while powerdevil was running, so
it vanished when the service was gone, taking Night Light and the theme
switch with it. Keep it loaded and say why brightness is unavailable.

BUG: 494514

media.caption: powerdevil stopped: Brightness & Color is gone from the tray, including its hidden items
powerdevil stopped: Brightness & Color is still listed in the tray
Its popup explains that brightness can't be adjusted because the Power Management service isn't running; Night Light and Theme still work
